testimonials.text: The fabric is unlike any shirt I own — it breathes like cotton but falls like silk. I've had endless compliments, and no two people have the same print.
testimonials.name: Daniyal Rehman

testimonials.text: You can feel the hand-work in it. The stitching, the weight, the way the colour sits in the cloth. This is a grown man's shirt, not a novelty print.
testimonials.name: Omar Sheikh

testimonials.text: I bought one for a wedding and now I reach for it constantly. Knowing it's one of one makes it feel like something worth keeping.
testimonials.name: Arjun Mehta
